note: The Workers AI image models the `cloudflare` provider offers (spec 8.7). Per model: how the request is sent (json or multipart) and which of Fugue's standard parameters (8.1) the model takes. A field left out is not sent. Prices are Cloudflare's published neuron prices (developers.cloudflare.com/workers-ai/platform/pricing, 2026-11-25) at $0.011 per 1,000 neurons, worked out for one 1024x1024 picture (4 tiles of 512x512); the Workers Free plan allows 10,000 neurons a day.
